text:
Carla: Heads-up — added a tiny experiment idea for sampling nudges in the console.
Ben: Curious, what counts as a 'nudge' here? UI banner? modal?
Carla: Small toast + inline suggestion on a route's telemetry pane. Not forced, just a one-click toggle.
Liam: For which routes? All noisy routes? PII-sensitive ones?
Carla: Targeting low-risk routes first — e.g., health-checks, system prompts, CDN callbacks. Non-customer-content routes.
Maya: How are we determining 'low-risk'? Heuristics? explicit allowlist?
Carla: Heuristics + tenant metadata. If route label == system OR has zero user_input flag, treat as low-risk. Also checking schema for text fields.
Ben: I worry about false positives. We should prefer explicit route opt-in from customers. Nudges can help but mustn't flip privacy settings.
Carla: Agreed. Nudge is only console-suggested change. Nothing auto-enables. We need audit trail + one-click undo.
Liam: Also need to ensure sampling change doesn't increase PII exposure in logs. Even if route is low-risk, some attachments could be customer-owned.
Maya: Can we add a dry-run mode? Console suggests change and previews how many more items would be sampled and examples (scrubbed) of what'd be captured.
Carla: Love that. Preview should show anonymized snippets with redaction applied.
Ben: Redaction rules are the tricky part. Are we using existing scrubbers (deid heuristics) or a new lightweight policy for preview?
Carla: Use the same deid heuristics used by the runtime, but run in 'preview-only' that masks tokens and replaces emails/phones with <REDACTED>. No raw content persisted.
Liam: Need to document TTL on preview logs and that previews are ephemeral. Ops will want this in the audit.
Maya: UX question: where do we show the cost delta? Teams care about token & storage cost.
Carla: On the same pane — tiny cost estimate card. Show expected tokens/day and sample rate change.
Ben: Implementation-wise: console toggles a sampling policy object on the route. It should be a declarative JSON blob. Example?
Carla: Pasted a quick proto in #code below:

```
{
  "route": "/api/ingest/callback",
  "sampling_policy": {
    "mode": "adaptive_nudge",
    "sample_rate": 0.05,
    "conditions": ["no_user_input", "route_label:system"],
    "redaction_profile": "standard_deid_v2",
    "preview_ttl_secs": 600,
    "audit_note": "console_nudge_v1"
  }
}
```

Liam: A couple of notes: 1) sample_rate should accept ranges or schedules (0.01-0.10); 2) preview_ttl needs to be enforceable by backend.
Carla: Agreed on ranges. Also want an opt-out flag for tenants with strict policies.
Maya: How will this interact with route-level quotas? If we increase sampling, we might blow through quota spikes.
Ben: Console should warn if projected sampled tokens/day > quota_threshold and suggest either lowering rate or increasing quota.
Carla: Good call. Add a preflight check that runs against last-30d traffic to estimate cost.
Liam: From infra side: ensure sampling change is applied at the ingress layer before any full request persistence. We can't let raw bodies hit long-term storage for previews.
Carla: That's the plan — runtime will short-circuit: if preview mode is on, send deid stream to ephemeral store only.
Maya: Security: need HMAC salt handling for pseudonymization. Salt must be per-tenant and never exposed to console.
Ben: We should add this note in UI help: "We pseudonymize identifiers using tenant-level HMAC — we don't store raw salts in the console."
Carla: ops-bot — can you add a deploy check that flags any console change that would enable preview mode without audit entries?
ops-bot: Deploy check created: sampling-preview-audit (FAIL if no audit log).
Liam: Also add a server-side limit: console can't create more than N preview entries per minute to avoid abuse.
Maya: Can previews include embeddings? That could leak semantics. I'd block embeddings in preview.
Carla: Good point — preview disallows embeddings and binary attachments.
Ben: For telemetry: we need new metrics — nudge_accept_rate, nudge_preview_views, projected_cost_delta. Add to route metrics.
Carla: Will wire those into the per-route dashboard and expose in the rollout table.
Liam: On rollout UX: show which tenants have accepted the nudge and allow bulk revert.
Maya: Legal asked for a simple checkbox in the audit UI: "data processed in preview adhered to redaction rules" that a human can check off.
Carla: We'll add that as part of the audit entry schema.
Ben: Ok next steps: 1) infra: implement preview TTL + ephemeral store (Liam); 2) runtime: apply deid pipeline to preview (Liam); 3) console: UI nudge + preflight cost check + preview UI (Carla/Maya); 4) security: HMAC docs + block embeddings (Ben).
Liam: I'll start a small infra spike and post the design doc link.
Carla: I'll prototype the UI mockups and sample flow.
Maya: I'll draft the help copy and legal checklist.
Ben: Ping me when you have the proto — I'll review redaction config.
Carla: thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Note: design doc created at https://redwood.internal/s/r/telemetry-nudge-proto (locks in 72h).
